name: Jellyfin
tagline: Self-hosted media streaming - multimedia streaming software.
shortDescription: Media server for audio, video, books, comics, and photos with a sleek interface and robust transcoding capabilities. Almost all modern platforms have clients, including Roku, Android TV, iOS, and Kodi.

cautionNotes: Key limitations: generated from community metadata, not a full security review. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
